WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink, o.dealedge AS side, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
), group_stats AS (
  SELECT orderslink, side,
         AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
         COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY orderslink, side
), side_stats AS (
  SELECT side, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS side_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM group_stats
  GROUP BY side
)
SELECT g.orderslink, g.side, g.avg_net_fee_rate, g.record_count,
       g.avg_net_fee_rate - s.side_avg_net_fee_rate AS difference
FROM group_stats AS g
JOIN side_stats AS s ON g.side = s.side
WHERE g.avg_net_fee_rate > s.side_avg_net_fee_rate
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
